verdict.rationale: RustDesk's own docs list unattended access with a permanent password as a core feature, which matches the story: credentials are set in advance so no one has to accept at the host. Wayland unattended and login-screen access exist only in a separate x86_64 Debian/Ubuntu preview, and a community user welcomed that Wayland unattended-access fix. missing for 10: in-depth documentation on pre-provisioning the permanent password at deployment time, unattended support on Wayland outside the preview build, and independent hands-on confirmation of unattended setup.
